description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing Project entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects, along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: ProjectAPI
classes.description: REST API controller class for Project entity management in the OrangeHRM Time module. Handles CRUD operations and validation for projects, with support for different response models and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all projects based on provided filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project after validating input parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes projects specified by IDs, with checks for existing timesheet entries.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a project.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single project.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a project.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Helper method to populate a Project entity from request parameters.

methods.name: getProjectCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Generates options to enforce uniqueness validations for project names under a customer.
